preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) >= 1 and len(S) <= 10**5 and all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S consists of characters '0' or '1' with length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'WIN' if all(len(S) == 0 or any(S[i] == '1' for i in range(len(S))) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]) else 'LOSE'
postconditions.description: The output is 'WIN' if and only if it is possible to remove all cards by always removing a face-up card ('1') and flipping adjacent cards when removed, otherwise 'LOSE'.
